phwstyle: Public Health Wales styling for R outputs

Source: R/phwstyle-package.R
phwstyle-package.Rd

phwstyle gives the outputs you already make one consistent, accessible house style. Write your analysis as usual, then add one function to style the result.

Getting started

  • phw_setup_check() lists the fonts, packages and tools each output needs, and offers to install what is missing.

  • use_phw_ggplot() styles every ggplot in the session.

  • vignette("phwstyle") explains how the pieces fit together (what is set once for a document, what is added to one chart, and how your own changes take priority), then walks through each output type. The script examples/phwstyle-demo.R in the source repository runs them all from one raw data frame.

  • The website, https://ch3w3y.github.io/phwstyle-r/, has a guide for charts, colours, tables, maps, documents and exports, and a gallery of every kind of output.

Charts

theme_phw(), theme_phw_map(), the scale_*_phw_*() colour and fill scales, scale_shape_phw(), scale_linetype_phw(), phw_sec_axis(), phw_finalise(), phw_save(), phw_arrange(), phw_style_extensions(), and public health charts: phw_epicurve(), phw_pyramid(), phw_funnel() and phw_spc().

Colours and accessibility

phw_colours, phw_pal() and the palettes in phw_palettes (including strategy for the Long-Term Strategy priorities and greens), phw_colour_key() (colours that stay with their groups across reports), phw_default_palette() (switching everything to the colour-blind safe accessible palette), phw_check_colours() and phw_cvd().

Tables

Build with phw_summary_table(), phw_crosstab(), phw_rate_table(), phw_risk_table() or phw_group_table(), then render with phw_flextable() (Word, PDF), phw_gt(), phw_reactable(), phw_datatable() or phw_write_xlsx() (Excel). use_phw_gtsummary() styles gtsummary tables.

Maps

phw_boundaries() downloads boundaries for every level of Welsh geography; phw_leaflet() makes interactive maps.

Documents, slides and apps

R Markdown formats (phw_html_document(), phw_word_document(), phw_pdf_document()), the Quarto extension (use_phw_quarto()), PowerPoint (phw_pptx(), phw_add_slide()), and Shiny (phw_bs_theme(), phw_page_navbar(), phw_header()).

Options

  • phwstyle.palette: default palette name, e.g. "accessible" for the colour-blind safe palette in every chart, table and widget. The environment variable PHWSTYLE_PALETTE and phw-palette in a document's YAML header do the same; see phw_default_palette().

  • phwstyle.font: font family to use instead of Ubuntu.

  • phwstyle.logo_dir: folder with your own logo files.

  • phwstyle.boundary_dir: where downloaded boundaries are cached.

  • phwstyle.boundary_update: FALSE stops phw_boundaries() checking for a newer list of boundary layers.

  • phwstyle.boundary_list_url: the address of that list. Point it at your own copy of boundaries.csv if your network blocks GitHub.

  • phwstyle.quiet: TRUE hides the startup reminder.
